subject: Rapid approval needed: off-cycle top-up + merit proposal for Ethan Park
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Rapid approval needed: off-cycle top-up + merit proposal for Ethan Park

Team —

Short version: manager is requesting an off-cycle equity top-up + accelerated merit for Ethan Park (Principal Engineer, Infrastructure) to prevent an imminent departure. He received a counteroffer from another employer and flagged this as a retention risk yesterday. Manager asks for an approval window this week so we can present the formal offer amendment on Monday.

Ask: approve a one-time equity refresh (~0.5% accelerated grant equivalent) + 12% base merit increase, effective 2/1/2026. Total comp impact runs against Eng retention pool (Q1 emergency buffer).

Why this is urgent:
- High replacement cost for role and project ramp (KV caching runtime lead).
- Candidate leverage is real — he has an offer with slightly higher cash but no clear long-term upside.
- Manager reports key deliverables tied to the new infra release that would slip if we lose him.

Attachments: 2026-01-15_ethan_offcycle_comp_proposal.pdf (proposal + manager notes), comp_model_v2.xlsx (impact to retention pool).

Notes: manager has confirmed verbal sign-off from their director; Marissa is included to provide the direct manager justification. Finance pre-check is preferred but we need leadership OK to move fast.

If you can reply with approval or a single follow-up question, I will coordinate the final memo and DocuSign flow.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Growth & Operations (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Rapid approval needed: off-cycle top-up + merit proposal for Ethan Park

Soojin —

Thanks for the heads up. A couple quick clarifying items before I can sign off:
1) Is this position a headcount change or purely comp rebalancing? (i.e., do we need to elevate a req?)
2) Has the manager documented alternatives explored (signing bonus, retention bonus, role stretch)?
3) Please confirm that the comp band floor/ceiling check was run and include the band/level rationale in the memo.

I will need a short one-page business case for the CEO (1 paragraph on business impact, 2 bullets on risk/alternatives). If Finance needs to confirm budget, loop them in but if the impact is within the retention pool we can route post-approval.

If you can get the manager justification and the band check into the Drive link today I can review and try to clear this afternoon.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rapid approval needed: off-cycle top-up + merit proposal for Ethan Park

I support the principle of an off-cycle adjustment here given the retention risk and project impact. A few items I want included in the final packet before I sign the memo:
- Short precedent note: has anyone approved >10% base increases + equity top-up in the last 12 months in Eng? If so, cite 1-2 examples.
- A clear replacement-cost rationale (recruiting timeline, expected ramp).
- Preferred split between cash vs equity for tax/ESG reasons. Consider smaller base + one-time performance bonus if that materially reduces long-term runway impact.

I'm attaching comp_model_v2.xlsx with two quick scenarios (12% base + 0.5% eq vs 8% base + 0.75% eq) — run numbers and recommend option in the memo. If the manager prefers the latter we could hit retention and be more budget-friendly.

If Laura is good after she gets the one-pager, I am fine signing off and routing to Finance for the final budget note.

—Vivek
VP, Product & Revenue Operations (interim)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rapid approval needed: off-cycle top-up + merit proposal for Ethan Park

Adding manager voice here — thanks for moving quickly. Per our conversation, summary of manager justification and alternatives explored attached (manager_justification_ethan.docx). Key points:
- Role scope has expanded (now leading cross-team infra migration) and results over the last 6 months have been above expectations.
- Manager tried a retention bonus first (proposed 15% one-time cash) but candidate preferred equity upside.
- Hiring a replacement for this senior infra engineer will take ~4 months and would require senior recruiter + targeted search.

Manager recommends Scenario B (8% base increase + 0.75% equity refresh) as the balanced approach. This preserves some budget and ties upside to company performance. If leadership prefers stronger immediate cash retention, manager can do a 10% signing bonus instead of bump but prefers equity as longer-term retention.

Please confirm final preference and I'll sign the manager approval section in the memo.

—Marissa
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

1) Manager and I agree to go with Vivek/Marissa Scenario B: 8% base increase + 0.75% equity refresh. This is the version we will present to Ethan.
2) Finance completed a short budget review and confirmed the retention pool can cover the incremental impact for Q1 (Finance note attached; see 2026-01-19_ethan_approval_memo.pdf).
3) I have prepared the executive approval memo and routed for signature via DocuSign (link below). Please sign by EOD tomorrow so People Ops can finalize the amended offer letter and equity grant.

Drive packet: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-ethan-comp

Thanks —
